description: Regional automated job-search schedules for Chief's Career department. Schedules run BOUNDED DRY-RUN scans only: they never write to a tracker and never submit anything. Tracker writes stay an explicit, backed-up, approval-gated step (career_ops_cli.py write --apply).
overlap_policy: Tasks are staggered and each writes a distinct run-health file, so overlapping runs cannot duplicate rows: dry-run scans never mutate state at all, and the deterministic runner keys each run by a hash of its accepted candidate set so a replayed run reports duplicates instead of new rows.

brief.mode: read-only aggregation; writes only the brief artifact under runtime/career-ops/daily-brief
brief.delivery: local file only; no external delivery channel is configured, attempted or assumed healthy
brief.note: The Career Daily Brief / Pipeline Prioritizer (roster B23). Morning time is chosen so the brief exists before the owner's working day; making the artifact available is all the schedule does. Delivering it to a messaging surface is a separate, unverified step (see career-ops/daily_brief_config.json#delivery).

uk.provider_coverage: 12 global/remote job boards + the owner's own ATS tracked_companies (existing lane, unchanged)
uk.notes: Wires the existing UK lane (portals.yml + data/pipeline.md + data/scan-history.tsv). Matches the historical ~23:48 local run window recorded in data/scan-runs.tsv. Reuses the owner's installation in place; no files are added to it.

dubai.provider_coverage: no UAE-specific provider exists in the Career Ops install; global/remote boards under an explicit UAE location scope
dubai.notes: Lane config created 2026-09-24 in the Chief control plane so the owner's Career Ops install stays untouched. Work authorisation for the UAE is UNKNOWN (see regional_policy.json) and is recorded as such on every accepted record.

japan.provider_coverage: no Japan-specific provider exists in the Career Ops install; global/remote boards under an explicit Japan location scope plus the region's search_queries for the agent-driven source path
japan.notes: Lane config created 2026-09-24 in the Chief control plane so the owner's Career Ops install stays untouched. Japanese work authorisation is UNKNOWN (see regional_policy.json) and is recorded as such on every accepted record.
